_doc: Wave 3 tier C fill (2026-11-25): the array hall, the dusk walk, the lake watch, the chart room and the star-iron mine.

people.role: Journeyman of the array hall, who keeps its silver book
people.backstory: Lays Phó Cương Đẩu's (pho_cuong_dau) ward rings across the plateau and keeps the array hall's silver book; the Pivot's war hall has paid him three times for rings round its camps, and he thinks the abbey should sell its stars the same way.

people.role: Steward of the dusk walk, who keeps its register
people.backstory: Keeps the register of the dusk walk and marks every Daoist who misses a star; Đổng Tịnh Hồ (dong_tinh_ho) has missed none since 1188 and walks the seventh star twice, and Tiêu has written that down without asking why.

people.role: Outer disciple from the yak village, the lake watcher's lamp-bearer
people.backstory: Came to the gate behind Ngô Hoàng Thảo's (ngo_hoang_thao) family yak the spring after her and carries the lake watcher's lamp; he trims it each night so that it never lights the patch of water Đổng Tịnh Hồ (dong_tinh_ho) watches first.
people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25 (fixB-5): no longer 'begun to notice'; trims the lamp

people.role: Inner disciple at Vẫn Tinh Khoáng, who sorts the star iron
people.backstory: Picks the true star iron out of Vẫn Tinh's spoil by its weight in her palm for Sầm Lạc Thiết (sam_lac_thiet), and each spring she weighs out the heaviest discs for the sack he flies to Thối Tinh's buyer.
people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25 (fixB-5): weighs out the discs Sầm sells

people.role: Outer disciple of the chart room, who mixes its inks
people.backstory: Mixes the chart room's inks and has copied Khuy Thiên's pole chart beside Phan Khắc Luân (phan_khac_luan); he called the extra star a flaw in the old paper to Bùi Thiên Đồ (bui_thien_do), and since the sailors' chart came he grinds the ink and says nothing.
people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25 (fixB-5): the sailors' chart came

people.role: Inner disciple of the array hall, sent on paid jobs
people.backstory: Lays ward rings faster than Trịnh Tiểu Đẩu (trinh_tieu_dau), so Phó Cương Đẩu (pho_cuong_dau) sends her on more of the paid jobs; she counts them in silver, and Trịnh counts them in the dusks she missed.

people.role: Outer disciple from the angelica village, who wipes the armillary's rings
people.backstory: Brought her village's angelica tithe up from Đương Quy and stayed; she wipes the star-iron rings of the Tuyền Cơ Nghi each dawn under Ân Chiếu Nguyệt (an_chieu_nguyet), and wants to be let in at night, when the readings are made.
